The things that bring us back to the mountains can also help us move forward in life. 

For Emmy, skiing has always been a source of joy and freedom. But when complications from Type 1 diabetes led to significant vision loss, her independence was suddenly in question. Her connection to the mountains and the friends she trusted took on new meaning. 

Discover My Ikon: My Journey, Emmy's Story. A new short film from Ikon Pass. 

Watch the full piece on the Lifted blog: https://lifted.ikonpass.com/my-ikon-my-journey/

In support of Emmy's journey, Ikon Pass is making a donation to the recipient of Emmy’s choice: University of Chicago's Islet Transplantation Research Fund, supporting research to advance treatments and improve quality of life for people living with Type 1 diabetes.

Black Friday is here at Alyeska Resort! ❄️✨
 
Our biggest deals of the season are officially live. Whether you're planning a winter ski getaway, looking to sharpen your skills on the slopes, or ready for a little well-deserved relaxation, there's something for everyone.
 
✨ Signature Rooms & Suites | 40% Off
Your next mountain getaway starts here. Save 40% on Signature Rooms and Suites and enjoy the best of Alyeska in every season.

Stay Dates: November 17, 2026 – November 2027
 
✨ Black Diamond Club Package
Take your winter getaway up a notch with an elevated stay on our exclusive Black Diamond Club floor.
Your package includes:
• Two-night minimum stay in Black Diamond Club accommodations
• Daily breakfast and evening après-adventure canapés
• Two Nordic Spa hydrotherapy passes per stay
• Two adult lift tickets per stay

Stay Dates: November 17, 2026 – April 24, 2027
 
🎿 Group Lessons | 40% Off
Make this the season you find your confidence on snow! Save 40% on Group Lessons and learn alongside others at your ability level, with lift tickets included.

Eligible Lesson Dates: December 8–18 and April 1–17
 
🎿 Alyeska Peak Pass Black Friday Bundle | 20% Off
Get your crew on the mountain this winter! Bundle a minimum of three Alyeska Peak Passes and save 20% on each pass. It's the perfect way to lock in a full season of skiing and riding, from first tracks to last chair.
 
✨ Give the Gift of Wellness
Give someone you love (or yourself) a little time to unplug and recharge. Earn a $20 Bonus Card for every $100 purchased on an Alyeska Nordic Spa e-gift card.
 
Gift cards can be used at the spa for hydrotherapy, massage, dining at Two Trees Bistro and retail, as well as throughout Alyeska Resort.
Offer Valid: November 6 – December 4, 2026

offer: Free all ages ULLR Fest event
title: ULLR Fest 2026
body:
Calling all Vikings! ⚔️❄️ ULLR Fest returns Saturday, Dec 5, 7–10 PM.

🔥 Sacrifice your old ski and snowboard gear to the bonfire (no gear? Donate to Protect Our Winters for a wooden one to toss)
🍷 Warm up with mulled wine and limited-edition Alyeska cups
👑 Best Fest Dress Contest: win a 2027/28 Alyeska Season Pass
🥃 $1 from every ULLR shot supports Protect Our Winters

Free and all ages! Keep the night going with High Step Society at the Sitzmark at 10 PM (21+, $30 tickets).
desc:
❄️ULLR Fest
📅Saturday, December 5, 2026
🕒7:00 PM - 10:00 PM
📍Sitzmark Bar & Grill
🎟️Free & open to the public

Join us as we honor ULLR, the Norse God of Snow, and summon a season full of powder! Gather around the roaring bonfire for the time-honored ski and snowboard sacrificial burning — bring your old gear and toss it into the flames as we cheer for epic winter adventures.

Don’t have any old gear to sacrifice? We’ve got you covered! We’ll have wooden skis and snowboards available to toss into the flames in exchange for a donation to Protect Our Winters. Plus, $1 from every shot of ULLR sold will go toward supporting their mission.

Warm up with our favorite Viking pastime, mulled wine! Bring your own cup or snag a limited-edition Alyeska cup, and raise a hearty toast to ULLR. Want to look the part? Grab a light-up Viking hat and join the festivities!

The Best Fest Dress Contest is BACK! Don your Viking hats, furs, cloaks, and jewels for a chance to win a 2027/28 ALYESKA SEASON PASS. Outfits must feature at least three pieces of flair to compete. No weapons allowed (real or imaginary…we’re looking at you, trolls and Vikings!).

This event is free to the public, and all ages are welcome!

The show at the Sitzmark kicks off at 10:00 PM; show is for 21+ only and requires a ticket for entry. Grab your tickets for High Step Society here: https://tinyurl.com/livesitz

SCHEDULE OF EVENTS:
7:00 PM Event Kick-off & Best Fest Dress Contest Registration Opens
8:00 PM Best Fest Dress Contest (must register by 7:45pm)
8:30 PM Performance
9:00 PM Raise a Glass to ULLR
10:00 PM Live at the Sitz: High Step Society | $30

“Skiing has given me a purpose in life.” — Lucas Herbert, @herb.media

A day in the mountains means something different to everyone. And sometimes, that meaning changes everything. 

For Lucas, a passion for skiing became a source of purpose during life’s darkest moments. In this raw, unfiltered account, he shares how his connection to the mountains and the community at Arapahoe Basin helped build a future he once struggled to imagine. 

Discover My Ikon: My Journey, Lucas's Story. A new short film from Ikon Pass. 

Watch the full piece on the Lifted blog. Link in bio. 

In connection with Lucas's story, #IkonPass is making a donation to Building Hope Summit County, a nonprofit of his choice dedicated to supporting mental wellness and expanding access to care in mountain communities. 

Next week, meet Emmy. Her love for skiing never changed, even when everything else did. Discover her story November 17.

title: A Mountain in the Making

body:
Some places you visit. Some places you become part of.

Revelstoke is a mountain in the making: North America’s longest lift-served vertical at 1,713 m, an average of 10.5 m of snow a year, and a real mountain town at its base. 

Winters are for deep powder. Summers are for bike trails, alpine adventure and long evenings downtown. 

Watch the series, then find your place on the mountain.

offer: Shop and sell ski and snowboard equipment at Ski Swap
title: Berkshire East Ski Patrol Ski Swap
body:
🎿 The Berkshire East Ski Patrol Ski Swap is back!

Join us on Sunday, November 15th, from 9 AM–2 PM to shop for skis, snowboards, winter gear, and more!

Have equipment you’d like to sell? Drop it off ahead of Sunday’s swap!

📦 Equipment Drop-Off:
• Friday, November 13: 3 PM–6 PM
• Saturday, November 14: 9 AM–5 PM
• No drop-offs on Sunday!
• No helmets will be accepted!

Seller Intake Form (please email to berkshire_ski@verizon.net): https://berkshireeast.com/images/2026_Berkshire_East_Ski_Swap_Form.pdf

Sellers keep 70% of the sale price, with 30% supporting the Berkshire East Ski Patrol. Maximum of 12 items per seller, with a $5 minimum price per item. Complete the seller intake form ahead of time or on-site during drop-off hours.

✅ Equipment Pick-Up & Payment:
Sellers must return Sunday, November 15, between 3 PM–5 PM to collect payment and any unsold equipment. Be sure to bring your invoice!

body:
Four Thursday nights. Two courses. One mountain under the moonlight.

The Moonlight Race Series returns to Sunlight for 2026/27. Choose the long or short course, race for a personal best, or bring friends and enjoy a night on the mountain with the uphill community.

Race dates: Dec. 17, Jan. 14, Feb. 18, and Mar. 18.

Swag, cold beer, and hot chocolate will be waiting at the finish. Grab your headlamp and register today.

offer: Register for The Heathen USA Skimo National Cup race
title: Race The Heathen
body:
The Heathen returns to Sunlight Mountain in 2027—and this year, it’s a USA Skimo National Cup race.

Choose your challenge: the Elite course covers approximately 11 miles and 5,500 feet of climbing; the Rec course covers approximately 6 miles and 2,000 feet. Both bring demanding climbs, technical transitions, and hard-earned descents.

Come chase National Cup points, take on a personal challenge, or find out what you’re made of.

Registration closes Friday, February 5 at 4 p.m. Register now for The Heathen.

Massanutten Resort worth it for a family trip? 👀

We drove about 8 hours from Atlanta to @massresort in Virginia with our 3 kids, and there was definitely no shortage of things to do.

If you're looking for a family vacation in Virginia, a family weekend getaway, or a place where kids of different ages can find something they enjoy, here's what we experienced:

🌊 Indoor WaterPark like water slides, lazy river, wave pool + FlowRider surf simulator
🎮 Arcade
🔐 Escape room
🏎️ Go-karts
🌲 Outdoor activities + Family Adventure Park
🏔️ And of course, the mountain views

We weren't able to do everything. The weather was too hot for us to spend time at the Adventure Park, so that's one I'll have to save for another visit. Some of those outdoor activities are weather-dependent, so that's something to keep in mind when planning. 

So, is Massanutten good for families?

For us, yes. Having so many activities in one resort made it easier to find something everyone wanted to do—and with 3 kids, that's a big deal. 😂

If you're searching for things to do with kids in Virginia, planning a Virginia family vacation, or looking for a family-friendly resort for your next getaway, save this one.

📌 Massanutten Resort — McGaheysville, Virginia
Would you take your family here? Have you been? Let me know in the comments!
